name: app-brain-extract
summary: Skull-strips a T1-weighted image with FSL 6.0.4 bet, with a configurable fractional intensity threshold and optional robust centre estimation or bias-field and neck cleanup.
description: run_bet.sh reads config.json and calls bet through brain_extract.py: frac sets -f, robust adds -R and bias_neck_cleanup adds -B. Use it for quick T1w brain extraction before registration or segmentation.

outputs.description: Skull-stripped T1w brain volume (FSL BET output)

parameters.description: BET fractional intensity threshold (0-1). Lower values give a larger brain estimate.
Use robust brain centre estimation (-R). Slower but more reliable for unusual head shapes.
Bias-field + neck-cleanup pass (-B). Recommended when neck is included in the FOV.

failure_modes.fix: Check the bet log; the input must be a valid T1w NIfTI.
